# Embedded Emissions: Cannot Compute

I cannot compute a definitive embedded-emissions figure for this scenario because a required input is missing.

## Inputs Check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in the table | 7201 (pig iron) | ✅ Present |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | Not stated | ❌ **Missing** |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 1,000 t | ✅ Present |

## Missing Input

- **Country of production.** The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country. CN 7201 has three different defaults in the table: **Türkiye, China and India**. Without the country, no single SEE can be selected, so the total cannot be determined.

## To Proceed

Please give the country of production. If it is one of the three listed above, I can calculate the result as SEE × 1,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places. If it is any other country, the table has no default value for it, and I still cannot compute the figure under the supplied rules.
